# THE NIGHT COUNT — 3D Asset Manifest
**Every model the game loads is now built for it**, in the project's own Blender scene at `~/Downloads/Blender Projects/night-count/`, from the builders in that folder's `src/props_*.py`. The one exception is the character rig and its animation library — rigging and animating a human is a different job from modelling a bottle.

The downloaded models below are what the game used to load. They were researched from sources with clearly stated licences, none was ripped from another game, and they are kept in the tree as reference. The single-file build works out what `MODEL` actually points at and ships nothing else, so none of them travels any more. Their licences are recorded here because they were downloaded, and a record of that does not expire.

## Built for this game — Blender, CC0 by the author

## Modifications made to downloaded assets

| Asset group | Modification | Why |
|---|---|---|
| all models | materials rebuilt as `MeshLambertMaterial`, diffuse map only | one art direction across three very different sources |
| all models | uniform rescale via `fitHeight`/`fitWidth` to real-world metres | sources disagree wildly on scale |
| Poly Haven props | model textures resized to 256px, jpeg q50 | texel density parity with the low-poly set |
| character mesh | per-vertex clothing colouring + rigid accessories (cap, uniform yoke) | the CC0 rig ships as an undressed mannequin; see `docs/ASSET_REQUIREMENTS.md` |
| character clips | retimed / cropped, root motion stripped | station work is slower than the library's default motion |

## Custom geometry (and why it is not a downloaded model)

The building shell — floor slab, walls, ceiling, partition walls, sales counter,
shelf gondolas, cooler run, fuel canopy deck and pump islands — is built from
boxes in `src/world/station.js`. This is **level design, not asset creation**:
these are the rooms the game is played in, and their dimensions are dictated by
sightlines, camera coverage and the customer pathing described in
`docs/SHIFT_PLAN.md`. Searches were run for a complete gas-station interior
(Poly Haven, poly.pizza, Sketchfab CC0, Kenney, Quaternius); the available
results are exterior-only shells or single-room kits that cannot be reshaped to
the required plan without more edits than building the plan directly. Every
*object* inside those rooms is a downloaded model.
